Use distributivity, $\mathbf b\times\mathbf b=\mathbf0$, and anticommutativity:

$$
\begin{aligned}(5\mathbf a-3\mathbf b)\times(6\mathbf b)&=30(\mathbf a\times\mathbf b)-18(\mathbf b\times\mathbf b)\\&=-30(\mathbf b\times\mathbf a)\\&=-30\langle1,-2,3\rangle\\&=\langle-30,60,-90\\rangle.\end{aligned}
$$
